# Fixture provenance

`upstream-legacy-text.excalidraw` is the decoded base64 scene payload from
[Excalidraw v0.18.1 test_embedded_v1.svg](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/v0.18.1/packages/excalidraw/tests/fixtures/test_embedded_v1.svg).
Only JSON formatting has changed. The source is an actual Excalidraw export
fixture, not a scene generated by this server. Excalidraw is MIT-licensed; see
`LICENSE.excalidraw` in this directory.

The backend tests additionally construct their own scenes with bindings, a small
embedded PNG, and unknown metadata to exercise lossless round-tripping. These
tests verify file-format behavior, not browser rendering or font metrics.
